reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds in our system before recording any payouts. I will list the refunds to compare.

The refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds in our system. Now I need to get the net balance for each customer by subtracting the refunds from the order amounts. I will list the orders to obtain the order amounts.
I have the orders and refunds. I need to calculate each customer's net balance (order amounts minus refunds). I will compute the net balance for each customer.
I have the net balance for customer acme (29756 cents). I need to get the net balance for customer birch next.
I have the net balance for customer birch (49879 cents). I need to get the net balance for customer cobalt next.
I have the net balance for customer cobalt (21752 cents). I need to record the payouts for each customer: acme 29756 cents, birch 49879 cents, cobalt 21752 cents. I will record each payout.
The payout for acme has been recorded successfully. I need to record the payout for birch (49879 cents) next.
